Do you adopt this decision?

before_proposal.message: The error of one prediction is the gap between the observed value and the predicted one. The mean absolute error (MAE) averages these gaps; the root mean squared error (RMSE) averages their squares, then takes the root, so one big miss weighs much more. Which of the two measures the error of this study? It is chosen now, before any model is fitted.

recommended.why: The MAE: every error weighs the same, and it reads in mpg. The RMSE is the alternative: one big miss weighs much more; choose it if one big miss costs much more than several small ones.
